## Proposed change
Fix for [issue #82789 ](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/82789). Integration now uses HTTPS by default, but optionally allows HTTP fallback for older routers. Also, SSL certificate verification can be turned off if needed.
Furthermore, the request timeout is reduced to 5 seconds, as the former value of 10 seconds seems to interfere with internal mechanisms / timeouts. I got strange exceptions reported as requests.exceptions.SSLError but clearly they wheren't. After reducing, they're correctly raised as Timeout / ReadTimeout.

issue_context.title: Swisscom integration broken due to switch from http to https
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Swisscom have recently defaulted the connections to work using https.  
The swisscom integration has http hardcoded, this maybe needs to be changed?
Device is internetbox 3

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.11.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2022.11.4

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

swisscom

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/swisscom/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
22-11-27 13:34:56.710 INFO (SyncWorker_2) [homeassistant.components.swisscom.device_tracker] Loading data from Swisscom Internet Box
2022-11-27 13:34:56.726 INFO (SyncWorker_2) [homeassistant.components.swisscom.device_tracker] No response from Swisscom Internet Box
2022-11-27 13:35:08.711 INFO (SyncWorker_5) [homeassistant.components.swisscom.device_tracker] Loading data from Swisscom Internet Box
2022-11-27 13:35:08.726 INFO (SyncWorker_5) [homeassistant.components.swisscom.device_tracker] No response from Swisscom Internet Box
```


### Additional information

From home assistant a ping to the internetbox is possible.
comments: I have tested locally changing to https and this resolves the issue - but a proper fix should be to check http and then accept the redirect to https.  My python know how is limited, if I have the time I will push a fix.

Swisscom is gradually rolling out the change to HTTPS and thus we need to check for the redirect. It's still possible to use the IP instead of the hostname (which the box is redirecting to). However, the TSL certificate will not be valid for the IP.

I played around with the module and my Internetbox3 this weekend. I didn't find a way with the request module to react on a redirect, I always get a ReadTimeout exception. My gut feeling is that this is because of the use of post  and not get.

But from a security point of view, I'm not a big fan of a redirect anyway. This would mean that an attacker could always downgrade to http and therefor insert wrong data. I prefer:

- changing the default behavior to HTTPS and to the new URL internetbox.swisscom.ch
- Let the integration report an error if https wasn't successful
- give the user the possibility to explicitly downgrade the connection to http. This can be done via configuration.yaml
- also give the user the possibility to turn off the SSL certificate validation if necessary (due to a URL change).

All these changes are possible without too much code changes. I've done them in a branch that is almost ready for a pull request. You find it [here](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/compare/dev...patrick-star:core:fix-swisscom-integration-broken-due-to-switch-from-http-to-https-%2382789). I should be able to create the PR tomorrow.
